gripOrHq.title: Encryption Breakthrough
gripOrHq.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

gripOrHq.title: Encoder, Inc.
gripOrHq.rulesText: Code gates cost [1] less to rez while Encoder, Inc. is rezzed. All code gates have an additional "End the run" subroutine after all other subroutines.

gripOrHq.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
gripOrHq.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

heapOrArchives.title: Holovid Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Holovid Campaign when you rez it. Take [1] from Holovid Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Holovid Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Management Shake-Up
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Chimera
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Chimera, trash a daemon.

scoreArea.title: Political Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

discardCards.title: Remote Detonator
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on a data fort this turn. Trash all rezzed ice on that fort, and the Corp gives you three tags.

discardCards.title: Faked Hit
discardCards.rulesText: Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Take 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

discardCards.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

discardCards.title: Garbage In
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Viral Pipeline
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Viral Pipeline
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

ice.title: Bolter Cluster
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

ice.title: Code Corpse
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Banpei
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Laser Wire
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
root.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

root.title: Holovid Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Holovid Campaign when you rez it. Take [1] from Holovid Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Holovid Campaign.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Chimera
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Chimera, trash a daemon.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.
